name: Amount
description: Numeric value of the action being authorized (e.g. transaction amount in the caller's base currency). Resolved from the decision request parameters.

name: ActionType
description: Category of the action being authorized (e.g. 'purchase', 'transfer', 'withdrawal'). Optional discriminator — default '' keeps action-specific conditions inert when omitted.

name: MfaCompleted
description: Whether the caller has completed step-up MFA for this session. Default false — an omitted value is treated as MFA NOT completed (fail closed).

name: ExceedsDenyLimit
description: Amount is greater than 2000 — replace 2000 with your own hard deny threshold.

name: ExceedsStepUpLimit
description: Amount is greater than 500 AND the caller has not completed MFA. Replace 500 with your own step-up threshold.

name: Deny — Amount Limit Exceeded
description: Returned when Amount exceeds the configured deny threshold.
payload: Amount {{d1d8fbef-475c-4de3-bca9-6295b6ee1b68}} exceeds the maximum permitted amount.

name: Permit — Step-Up Required
description: Returned when the action is permitted but requires step-up MFA before proceeding.
payload: Amount {{d1d8fbef-475c-4de3-bca9-6295b6ee1b68}} requires step-up authentication before this action can proceed.

name: Permit — Approved
description: Returned for a standard, unconditional approval.

name: Deny Over Limit
description: DENY when Amount exceeds the hard deny threshold (ExceedsDenyLimit). Unconditional — applies regardless of ActionType or MfaCompleted.

name: Require Step-Up
description: PERMIT with a step-up obligation when Amount exceeds the step-up threshold and MFA has not been completed (ExceedsStepUpLimit). The caller reads the step_up_required statement code off the decision to prompt for MFA and retry with MfaCompleted=true.

name: Permit Standard
description: PERMIT everything not caught by Deny Over Limit or Require Step-Up. This is the catch-all — every policy needs exactly one rule with condition {empty:{}} so an action that matches no other rule still resolves to a decision instead of INDETERMINATE.

name: Example Transaction Authorization
description: Evaluates Amount, ActionType, and MfaCompleted against policy rules. DenyOverrides: if any rule produces DENY the final decision is DENY. Rules in priority order: (1) DENY if Amount > 2000; (2) PERMIT+step-up if Amount > 500 and no MFA; (3) PERMIT otherwise.

name: Example Policies
description: Root policy set. Contains: Example Transaction Authorization. DenyOverrides with evaluateAll=true ensures every child policy is evaluated and any DENY wins.
